source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1110 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1110 was established by Ordinance No. 32786 passed by the Dallas City Council on June 26, 2024. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1110 is established on property located on the south side of L.B.J. Freeway between Montfort Drive and Noel Road. The size of PD 1110 is approximately 8.60 acres. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a nonresidential zoning district. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article:

Exhibit 1110A: development plan. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Except as provided in this section, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, and development schedule do not apply.

(b) For a project containing more than 250 dwelling units, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1110A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the MU-2 Mixed Use District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-2 Mixed Use District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the MU-2 Mixed Use District only by Specific Use Permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review
(DIR) in the MU-2 Mixed Use District is subject to DIR in this district, etc. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-2 Mixed Use District apply.

(b) Front yard.

(1) For frontage on L.B.J. Freeway, minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(2) For frontage on Noel Road and Montfort Drive, minimum front yard is 10 feet.

(3) Urban form setback is not required.

(c) Side and rear yard.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this subsection, minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(2) Tower spacing. Tower spacing is required for any parking structure that existed on June 26, 2024.

(d) Density.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum dwelling unit density is 50 units per acre.

(2) Increased development standards. If compliant with Section 51P-1110.114, maximum dwelling unit density is 90 dwelling units per acre.

(e) Floor area ratio. Maximum floor area ratio is 4.0.

(f) Height.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 182 feet.

(2) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Except for chimneys, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the slope to a height 12 feet above the slope and 12 feet above the maximum structure height. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) Multifamily. If compliant with Section 51P-1110.114, minimum parking must be provided in accordance with Section 51A-4.1107(c). (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Sustainable Design Features For A Project
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.110. SUSTAINABLE DESIGN FEATURES FOR A PROJECT CONTAINING MIXED INCOME HOUSING.

(a) Drip irrigation. Drip irrigation must be utilized for maintenance of landscaping.

(b) Recycling. Recycling containers must be available for all users. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Landscaping must consist of plant species that are native or adapted to north central Texas with reduced, low, or very low water consumption characteristics.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Development Bonus                 For     A    Mixed       Income
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.114. DEVELOPMENT BONUS FOR A MIXED INCOME HOUSING PROJECT.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section and if compliant with Section 51P- 1110.110, the development bonuses identified in Sections 51P-1110.108 and 51P-1110.109 apply if a minimum of five percent of the total number of units are available to households earning between 81 and 100 percent of the area median family income and are in compliance with Division 51A-4.1100, as amended.

(b) Design standards. Except as provided in this article, a mixed income housing project must be designated in accordance with Section 51A-4.1107.

(1) Open space. A minimum of 65,000 square feet of open space is required.

(2) Parking structure. No active use or exterior facade similar in materials, architecture, and appearance to the facade of the main structure is required for a parking structure that existed on June 26, 2024.

(3) Street level individual entries. Street-level residential uses fronting L.B.J. Freeway are not required to have individual entries that access the street with an improved path connecting to the sidewalk

(4) Sidewalks.

(A) Sidewalks along L.B.J. Freeway must be located in an area parallel to and between five feet and 25 feet of the back of the projected street curb.

(B) All other sidewalks must be located in an area parallel to and between two feet and 25 feet of the back of the projected street curb.

(5) Pedestrian lighting. Pedestrian lighting must be provided at regular intervals along all building facades facing a public street.

(6) Bicycle parking. Bicycle parking must be located along street frontages. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32786)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1110.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32786)
